fullContent:
Karanja Tailam (Oil) 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali, Visarpa Chikitsa 57/25. 
 Introduction 
 Karanja Tailam (Oil) is an herbal oil. It is used in the treatment of herpes, boils and abscesses. It should be strictly used under medical supervision. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Karanja – Pongamia pinnata 
 Saptachada – Alstonia scholaris 
 Langali – Gloriosa superb 
 Snuhi – Euphorbia nerifolia 
 Arka – Calotropis procera 
 Anala – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Bhringaraja – Eclipta alba 
 Turmeric – Curcuma longa 
 Gomutra – Cow urine 
 Visha – Aconitum ferox 
 Taila – Oil of Sesamum indicum 
 
 Indications 
 
 Herpes 
 Boils 
 Abscesses 
 Eczema 
 
 How to Use? 
 For external use only. It should not be used without doctor’s advice. 
 Side Effects 
 Note – This oil should not be used in children and pregnant women. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
